sources.name: Central Bank of Egypt - Mobile Wallets (last updated 23 Mar 2023)
GLACO - CBE regulations for licensing, registration and supervision of digital banks (Law 194/2020)

notes: The corpus has no CBE agent-banking regulation in its own words (the agent rules sit inside the mobile-wallet rules, which are only present in Arabic), so the agent model here is documented through the wallet and Fawry material. Counts of agent points are the operators' own claims.

entries.subject: wallet_issuance_model
entries.value_text: banks and their agents (mobile network operators)
entries.display: Wallets are issued by banks, extended through their agents
entries.quote: It is provided through banks and their agents (mobile network operators).
entries.notes: The telecom brand (Vodafone Cash, Etisalat Cash) is the front end; the licensed issuer is a bank.

entries.subject: wallet_registration_locations
entries.value_text: bank branch, telecom company or bank agent
entries.display: Onboarding happens at a bank branch, a telco shop, or a bank agent
entries.quote: Visit the nearest branch of the bank, telecommunications companies, or bank agents
entries.notes: Agent-assisted onboarding is the norm for wallets, unlike bank accounts.

entries.subject: wallet_cash_network
entries.value_text: ATMs, bank branches, MNO stores and service agents
entries.display: Cash in/out runs through ATMs, branches, telco stores and agents
entries.quote: Through ATMs, bank branches, mobile network operator stores, and service agents

entries.subject: vodafone_cash_agent_points
entries.display: 450,000 deposit and withdrawal points for Vodafone Cash
entries.quote: with a click of a button and the receiver will simply cash out the money from 450,000 points of deposit & withdrawal
entries.notes: Vodafone presents the cash-out network as the wallet's main distribution advantage. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: vodafone_cash_deposit_partners
entries.value_text: Vodafone stores, exclusive dealers, Basata, Aman, Fawry and ATMs
entries.display: Cash-in via Vodafone stores, dealers, Basata, Aman, Fawry or ATMs
entries.quote: Deposit/Withdraw money in your account through Vodafone’s stores, exclusive dealers, Basata, Aman, Fawry branches or ATM machines
entries.notes: Third-party retail chains act as cash-in points for a bank-issued wallet; the Money Transfer page lists the same outlets plus named bank ATMs. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: fawry_retail_pos_model
entries.value_text: retail agent points using Fawry POS terminals
entries.display: Fawry acceptance runs on POS terminals in kiosks and supermarkets
entries.quote: Pay your bills at endless Fawry retail network, from kiosks to supermarkets, using Fawry’s POS.
entries.notes: Merchant-side description of the point model: one provider accepts, processes and settles. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: fawry_plus_stores
entries.display: Fawry also runs its own branded Plus stores
entries.quote: Settle your payments via any of our Fawry Plus branches.
entries.notes: Two-tier model: branded Plus stores plus third-party retail POS points. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: digital_bank_agent_permission
entries.display: Digital banks may use agents only with CBE approval
entries.quote: Permission to use banking agents after obtaining the CBE's approval
entries.notes: From CBE's digital-bank licensing conditions as summarised by GLACO; digital banks are otherwise branch-restricted. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02). [normalised: categorical answer, grade with quote]

entries.subject: egypt_post_institutional_type
entries.display: Egypt Post is the state postal agency
entries.quote: is the governmental agency responsible for postal service
entries.notes: Source is Wikipedia, not a primary document. Nothing in the corpus states that Egypt Post acts as a banking agent, so no such fact is encoded.
